Stages of review_facility_ed_visits()

Source: R/utils-review.R
check_percentile_order.Rd

Internal helpers that review_facility_ed_visits() runs in order, so the exported function reads as a short pipeline.

Usage

check_percentile_order(
  percentile_low,
  percentile_high,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

resolve_review_date_col(data, date_col_quo, call = rlang::caller_env())

inform_review_defaults(
  data,
  type_col_str,
  use_time_norm,
  group_by_type,
  verbose
)

count_facility_visits(
  data,
  fac_col_str,
  type_col_str,
  use_time_norm,
  date_col_str
)

add_outlier_thresholds(
  facility_counts,
  detect_col,
  type_col_str,
  group_by_type,
  method,
  percentile_low,
  percentile_high,
  iqr_multiplier
)

flag_outliers(facility_counts, detect_col, method)

outlier_method_label(x, pct_low, pct_high, iqr_low, iqr_high)

arrange_review_result(facility_counts, detect_col, return_format)

inform_review_summary(facility_counts, method, group_by_type, verbose)

Arguments

percentile_low, percentile_high

Lower and upper percentile thresholds, each already validated as a number in [0, 1].

call

The environment errors are attributed to; see resolve_col().

data

A data frame already passed through clean_names_safe().

date_col_quo

The captured date_col expression (a quosure from rlang::enquo()), possibly NULL.

type_col_str, fac_col_str

Names of the facility type and facility columns in data.

use_time_norm

Logical. Whether visits are normalized to visits per day.

group_by_type

Logical. Whether thresholds are computed within facility types.

verbose

Logical. Whether to emit informational messages.

date_col_str

Name of the date column, or NULL.

facility_counts

The per-facility count data frame built so far.

detect_col

Name of the count column outliers are detected on: "visits_per_day" or "n_visits".

method

One of "percentile", "iqr", or "both".

iqr_multiplier

Non-negative number: the IQR fence multiplier.

x, pct_low, pct_high, iqr_low, iqr_high

The detection column and the four thresholds, as parallel vectors. A threshold that is NA (the method was not requested) never fires.

return_format

One of "outliers_only" or "all".

Value

check_percentile_order() returns NULL invisibly or aborts. resolve_review_date_col() returns a list with use_time_norm and date_col_str. inform_review_defaults() and inform_review_summary() are called for their messages. The remaining stages return the updated facility_counts data frame. outlier_method_label() returns a character vector the length of x.

Details

The stages, in the order review_facility_ed_visits() calls them:

  1. check_percentile_order() aborts unless percentile_low is below percentile_high.

  2. resolve_review_date_col() resolves the optional date_col, warning and falling back to raw visit counts when it is absent.

  3. inform_review_defaults() emits the informational messages about the defaults in effect.

  4. count_facility_visits() counts visits per facility and facility type. When a date column is available it also reports n_days (the days the facility sent data) and visits_per_day, which divides by the number of distinct dates in the whole pull rather than by n_days, so a facility that stops sending partway through the pull scores lower instead of looking the same as one that sent every day. The divisor is the same for every facility, so the rate ranks facilities exactly as the count does and flags the same ones.

  5. add_outlier_thresholds() adds the percentile and/or IQR thresholds, optionally within facility types. Only the quantiles the chosen method actually uses are computed: the IQR quantiles would be wasted work (recomputed per group) under the default method = "percentile", and vice versa.

  6. flag_outliers() adds the .outlier_* columns and drops the threshold helper columns. .outlier_method records the criterion that fired ("percentile", "iqr", or "percentile+iqr"), not the requested method. method is a single scalar for the whole call, so the comparison is chosen once with if/else rather than dplyr::case_when(), which is deprecated for a scalar condition as of dplyr 1.2.0.

  7. arrange_review_result() applies return_format.

  8. inform_review_summary() reports how many facilities were flagged.
